uncited: NeRF-Det Training Objectives define the loss functions used to jointly optimize a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) branch and a 3D object detection branch in a single end-to-end framework.
The method jointly trains the detection and NeRF branches end-to-end.
- Ground truth 3D bounding boxes for the detection branch.
Object categories (27 location candidates per object).
If depth ground truth is not available, $L_d$ is omitted.
-   **Loss Balance:** The ablation study indicates that photo-metric loss alone provides sufficient geometry cues, performing close to depth supervision alone.
-   **No NeRF Optimization at Test Time:** The NeRF branch is not optimized per scene during inference.
NeRF-Det was introduced to address the ambiguity of volume representations in multi-view 3D object detection.
